# kkp_datacenters (Data Source)

Lists the datacenters clusters can be created in.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kkp_datacenters" "openstack" {
  cloud_provider = "openstack"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cloud_provider` (String) Only datacenters of this cloud provider, e.g. `openstack`.
- `seed` (String) Only datacenters of this seed.

### Read-Only

- `datacenters` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--datacenters))
- `names` (List of String)

<a id="nestedatt--datacenters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `datacenters`

Read-Only:

- `cloud_provider` (String) Cloud provider, e.g. `openstack`.
- `country` (String) ISO country code.
- `images` (Map of String) Default image per operating system.
- `location` (String) Human-readable location.
- `name` (String)
- `openstack_auth_url` (String) Keystone URL (OpenStack).
- `openstack_availability_zone` (String) Default availability zone (OpenStack).
- `openstack_enforce_floating_ip` (Boolean) Whether nodes must get floating IPs (OpenStack).
- `openstack_region` (String) Region (OpenStack).
- `seed` (String) Seed cluster hosting the datacenter's control planes.
